authority: owner-forwarded R3_scaling_recovery_instruction.md + R3_scaling_recovery_plan.md (R3.0-R3.2; R3.3 one challenger only under the R3.2 gate; R3.4 diagnostic; R3.5 conditional on R3.4; R4 NOT authorized)

frozen_reference_F0.arm: D (coupled X/Y, order pred), trained on snapshot abf_v32_fb0eef4f5ff433ee
frozen_reference_F0.note: production K<=3 bundle is never modified; scaling checkpoints live under naren_workspace/fig3/r3/ckpt with their own hashes

terminology.K*: certified minimum (only with a sound bound)
terminology.X: ordered execution incl. terminal planned+executed connector to q_ref
terminology.HYPSTART: static ideal-pose start layout (not an executed prefix)

splits.TRAIN_SCALE: new local labels on original-TRAIN families with no DEV lineage and no R1/R2/R2.4 physical exposure (common3.exposure)
splits.VAL_SCALE: new local labels on original-VAL families with the same exclusions (family-disjoint from TRAIN_SCALE by the original split)
splits.REPLAY: original v32 TRAIN rows minus DEV-lineage families (3D: 44 rows dropped; 2D: 0)
splits.NATURAL_VAL: original v32 VAL X/Y labels on non-exposed families (K<=3 regression panel; never used for early stopping)
splits.DEV_ORDER_3D: the 20 exposed K4/K5 roots of r2/r23/roster_3d.jsonl (R2.4 known assignments; evaluator-only witness)
splits.DEV_PLAN_3D: same 20 roots (R3.5, only if R3.4 passes)
splits.DEV_ORDER_2D: new 2D witness cohort (R3.1 3B), sealed after generation, before any order-recovery query
splits.never: TEST, release_v2 (data or metadata), R2/R2.4 exposed roots and DEV lineage in any training / early stopping / selection

teacher_audit.3d: DET 8 / HYP 12 / DER 6 / TRN 8 jobs (parity.py, sealed)
teacher_audit.2d: DET 8 queries; x_query == x_chunked({m}) reused from R1 (3/3)

R3_0.stop_rule: any unresolved DET / HYP / TRN disagreement -> mark distinct contracts and stop affected evaluation

R3_1_3d.policy: data.py docstring (templates T1-T7, sources P/R/H/W, HYPSTART every third scene, k = 3 / 2 alternating)

scenes.priority: K_legacy >= 1 first, sha256('R3.1|scene|root') order, one root per family

R3_1_3d.expansion: <= 400 more jobs ONLY if after the pilot VAL_SCALE has < 10 mixed families at h0 or at h>=1 (new VAL families) or TRAIN_SCALE has < 60 negatives at h>=1 (new TRAIN families); same policy
R3_1_3d.labels: labels.chunks_of contract (completed chunk incl. connector = 1; failing chunk = 0; connector failure = 0 tagged; chunks after a failure unobserved; UNKNOWN never negative)
R3_1_3d.Y: not collected (X-only marginal likelihood; job y = null)

R3_1_2d.diagnostic: <= 60 X-only queries on clean 2D VAL families (N 13-20, K_legacy >= 1): templates T2, T3, T6, T7 (h0 + h1 labels); never end-to-end selection
R3_1_2d.decision: frozen marginal pX at h>=1 on (R2.4 2D panel + diagnostic panel), >= 10 mixed families required: PASS if AUROC >= 0.75 and cluster lower CI >= 0.60; DEFICIT if cluster upper CI < 0.70; else INCONCLUSIVE (no 2D X training, no graph model)
R3_1_2d.targeted: <= 600 queries / 8 CPU-h on new clean TRAIN/VAL families with the 3D-style design ONLY if DEFICIT

cohort.generator: k3scale gen_deep.py (GENDEEP3 SA on MINK_STATIC_V2 K_lb, parking prior) with STRING seeds 'R3COH2D|<i>' (namespace disjoint from every integer seed of earlier campaigns; release_v2 never read)
cohort.witness: k3scale witness_v3.py (frozen <=6-relocation BXY teacher via teacher_long, independent X/Y replay, Y(empty) measured)
cohort.accept: X = 1 and Y = 1 replayed, Y(empty) = 0, L in {4,5,6}, N in [9,15] where possible; label CERTIFIED_MIN_K iff L = K_lb(V1) = K_lb(V2) (sound bound => no shorter repair), else WITNESS_LEN_L_MIN_UNKNOWN
cohort.order: candidate layouts in sha256('R3COH|'+fingerprint) order per L until 10 accepted or caps

F1.verified_by: audit.params autograd map (x_only = act, mix, order_s, pairo, xy; Y-only = scene; shared = enc, pooln, edit_proj, edit_head, ctxn)
F1.data: REPLAY + TRAIN_SCALE scene-views (one view per start scene, X nodes per chunk; permutations share the endpoint Y node; Y unobserved -> exact marginal likelihood)
F1.batch: 32 replay roots + 32 TRAIN_SCALE scene-views (family-balanced sampling) per step; epoch = ceil(|REPLAY| / 32) steps
F1.select: seed with lower best VAL_SCALE family-mean NLL
F1.checks: Y logits on REPLAY / NATURAL_VAL / VAL_SCALE identical to F0 (max abs diff <= 1e-6); frozen-parameter hashes unchanged; cVAE hash unchanged

F2.only_if: F1 fails the local gate and data adequate
F2.y_preservation: none added; reject F2 if NATURAL_VAL Y AUROC drops > 0.02 or K<=3 p11 AUROC drops > 0.05 (point) / CI excludes -0.05

local_gate.support: >= 10 mixed families at h0 and at h>=1 on VAL_SCALE (else INCONCLUSIVE / DATA_LIMITED)
local_gate.h>=1: marginal pX AUROC >= 0.75 and family-cluster lower 95% CI >= 0.60
local_gate.paired: AUROC(model) - AUROC(F0) on VAL_SCALE h>=1 with family-cluster bootstrap 95% CI excluding 0
local_gate.first_relocation_FPR: on VAL_SCALE h0 m1: threshold per model = score at TPR 0.80; FPR(F0) - FPR(model) >= 0.15 (TPR reported; also at 0.5)
local_gate.reported: h0, m1/m2/m3, N bins, HYPSTART separately; AUPRC, NLL, ECE, Brier; within-family matched permutation concordance (T4/T5)

k3_regression.metrics: p11 AUROC vs z, marginal pX AUROC vs x, Y identity, NOOP gate decisions
k3_regression.target: <= 0.05 AUROC loss, CI reported; non-inferiority not claimed unless CI supports it
k3_regression.physical: <= 60 3D jobs / 80 2D queries ONLY on NATURAL_VAL roots whose production selection changes (F0 vs selected)

outcomes: PASS -> R3.4 with F1 (no F2 / G1)
F1, F2 FAIL + data adequate -> R3.3 G1

R3_3.G1: X-only relational encoder (object nodes: learner-visible xy, attrs, query/target roles; typed context: base/robot, goal, destination; edges: relative offset, distance, size difference); 2 layers of query-conditioned relational attention, hidden 128; per-step prefix scene tokens + predecessor mixer -> a, w; Y branch = frozen F0 (bitwise)
R3_3.control: capacity-matched raw-feature MLP X head (same inputs, no message passing) under identical data / replay / optimizer / epochs
R3_3.checks: object-index permutation invariance, action-order sensitivity, no future-prefix leakage, identical Y, finite gradients
R3_3.select: smallest model passing the R3.2 gate on VAL_SCALE; else REPRESENTATION_OR_DATA_LIMITED STOP

arms.S-DP: selected scaling model, exact subset DP (order.dp, LAM = -log 0.92 fixed as R2.4), selected partition executed
arms.F0-DP: R2.4 A-DP (same chunked mode, archived exact jobs reused)
arms.RANDOM: permutation from sha256('R3.4|'+root) with the selected model's best partition for that order

3d.outcome: X = 1 and Y = 1 with independent replay
3d.decision: >= 14/20 RECOVERED (also needs local gate PASS and S-DP - F0-DP >= +5 roots with exact one-sided McNemar p < 0.05); 10-13 PARTIAL; <= 9 NOT_RECOVERED
3d.lambda0: offline diagnostic only; frozen before dispatch

R3_4.2d: only if 2D X passes (frozen or trained) and the cohort has >= 10 accepted roots; same arms with 70% / 50% thresholds; <= 180 queries

R3_5.addendum: arm-level details (FIG3 / GA with X-aware diverse retention vs Y-only shortlist, flat insertion, B0, D4 vs union) sealed in R3_5_ADDENDUM.json before any R3.5 physical job
R3_5.known_bottleneck_R3_0: GA Y-only top-4 shortlist: verified witness sets rank 349-11897 by Y_global among 4k-45k same-size sets (12 roots in pool)
